sloka: तरु प्रवाल रक्ता सा नील अंगम् राक्षस ईश्वरम् ।प्राशोभयत वैदेही गजम् कक्ष्या इव कांचनी ॥३-५२-३०॥
transliteration: taru pravāla raktā sā nīla aṁgam rākṣasa īśvaram ।prāśobhayata vaidehī gajam kakṣyā iva kāṁcanī ॥3-52-30॥

translations.english: With her golden girdle, Sita whose complexion resembled tender leaves looked like a golden chain to bind an elephant with. (Here Ravana is the elephant).
